intended_use: Reference-guided material studies on exact existing canonical construction carrier prototypes; geometry remains immutable and unapproved.

materials.rough_timber: domain-warped longitudinal grain, knots, sparse tapered fissures and rough-sawn relief
materials.worked_timber: finer grain, quiet knots and restrained flush longitudinal seams
materials.stone_masonry: Pale, gently coursed stone with variable course widths, subtle mineral variation, soft continuous mortar shoulders, and restrained relief.
materials.worked_timber_ornamented: Uses the exact v009 worked-timber master basecolor, roughness, normal, and height bytes; color-only nested diamond front motif and inset quiet back border.

maps.basecolor: sRGB PNG; ornament face variants use separate color maps only
maps.normal: tangent +Y OpenGL PNG derived from physical height in metres
